register.labelZh: ROUND 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: ROUND 表達可以說明價格、時間、重量或其他數字已被調整至較容易使用的數值。；你可以用 round off 表示以合適方式結束一頓飯、課堂、旅程、演講或活動。；農夫集合動物、主辦人集合人員,或警方拘捕一批人時,都可以使用 round up。；round off 可以表示磨圓邊緣或合適地結束活動;round on 則表示突然憤怒地斥責某人。
register.summaryEn: ROUND expressions help you show that a price, time, weight or other number has been adjusted to an easier figure. You can use round off to describe ending a meal, lesson, trip, speech or event in a suitable way. Round up is useful when a farmer gathers animals, an organiser gathers people or the police arrest a group. Round off can describe smooth edges or a suitable ending, while round on describes a sudden angry reaction.
